text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Kikuka Sho. Before deciding to enter, 
there had been quite a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did ya know, Trainer? What the 
media's been callin' me lately?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Is that literal?! No way! I'm the "Ritto 
Secret Weapon"!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, seems there's someone out there who 
recognizes my potential. And on top of 
that, here's what else they're sayin' 
about me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"'She'll truly come into her own next 
year. So, it's better not to enter her in 
the Kikuka Sho.' Or so they said."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Course it's frustratin'! I don't care if 
it ain't a secret weapon! Make it a 
totally obvious weapon!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why, right here and now, I'm gonna 
show 'em. Just what I'm capable of!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if I won't reach my full strength 
till next year, this'll be my souvenir! 
The final jewel of the Classics, I'm 
takin' it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tamamo Cross proudly entered the 
Kikuka Sho, meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The color most befitting the season of 
chrysanthemums is...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The color most befitting the season of 
chrysanthemums is—gold. Yeah, that 
definitely shines the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure all the other colors serve 
as mere accents. Because I'm the one who's 
gonna shine brightest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto, 3000m. Competing for the final 
crown, early bloomers and late bloomers 
clash fiercely.
